items.title: Gucci Celebrates the Season with 2026 Holiday Campaign (Photos)
items.summary: WWD photo gallery covering Gucci's 2026 Gucci Gift holiday campaign starring Mariah Carey, directed by Harmony Korine, showcasing the Butterfly capsule (jackets, dresses, jewelry with crystal butterfly motifs) alongside Starlet, GG Marmont and Paparazzo bag styles staged inside a transformed hotel set.

items.title: Gucci Releases GucciCore Campaign Photographed by Peter Funch in New York
items.summary: Aggregator report (cross-checked against designer/brand materials) on Gucci's new GucciCore campaign shot by Peter Funch on New York streets, extending the permanent core-wardrobe collection (peacoats, trench coats, suits, shirts, pencil skirts) that Demna first showed at a Times Square runway event; management has flagged GucciCore as the line meant to broaden Gucci's North American customer base beyond fashion-forward buyers.

items.title: Earnings call transcript: Kering Q3 2026 shares sink as Gucci recovery lags
items.summary: Earnings-call transcript detailing Gucci's Q3 2026 comparable sales decline of 6% (retail sales down 9%), with North America turning negative after several quarters of growth; management blamed a tough prior-year comparison base and a Primavera collection skewed toward fashion-forward rather than broad-aspirational shoppers, while pointing to the incoming GucciCore line as the fix. Kering ADRs fell nearly 12% on the print; management said the priority is to 'rebuild desirability.'

items.title: Fans Are 'Disappointed' Over Mariah Carey's 'Depressing' Gucci Holiday Campaign & 'Boring' Styling
items.summary: Roundup of TikTok reactions to Gucci's Mariah Carey holiday film describing it as gloomy, dated, and 'emotionless,' with viewers comparing the hotel-party set to a horror film ('vampire party vibes,' 'AHS episode') and one commenter saying the ad 'feels like if JCPenney was trying to be luxury' despite the celebrity casting.

items.title: TikTok user reactions to Gucci x Mariah Carey holiday film
items.summary: Public TikTok comment threads reacting to the Gucci Gift campaign video; sampled comments call the production 'cold,' 'boring,' 'depressing' and say viewers 'would not attend that party' depicted in the ad, contrasting the somber tone with the upbeat 'All I Want for Christmas Is You' soundtrack.

items.title: Gucci SS27 Show thread
items.summary: PurseForum discussion thread tracking member reactions to Gucci's Spring/Summer 2027 runway show under Demna; thread remains an active running discussion among US-based collectors through early November, part of ongoing community sentiment-tracking on Demna-era design direction. Flagged here for its PRIORITY-A community source status in buzz_registry even though the original post predates the 14-day freshness window; cited for ongoing activity level, not as a standalone fresh story.

items.title: Gucci Reviews (From First-hand Experiences)
items.summary: Rolling US consumer review aggregator with recently added reviews citing quality complaints (shoes falling apart, watch malfunction, bag zippers breaking, sunglasses degrading, belt rhinestones falling out) and dissatisfaction with customer service relative to price point; used here as critical-angle counterweight to brand-driven campaign coverage.

items.title: TRR Top 5: Gucci Bags With The Best Resale Value
items.summary: US resale-platform guide (cross-checked, retailer-affiliated content) noting authenticated pre-owned Gucci typically trades 30-50% below boutique retail overall, though current icons (GG Marmont, Jackie 1961, Horsebit 1955, Ophidia) hold 55-80% of retail; flags that older/dated styles can fall to 30-50% retention, used as secondhand-market signal on brand desirability.

items.title: Mariah Carey Stars in Gucci's Holiday 2026 Campaign
items.summary: US lifestyle-media writeup of the Gucci Gift campaign reiterating product details (Starlet, GG Marmont, Paparazzo bags; Butterfly capsule) and confirming the Harmony Korine direction and in-store NYC activation tied to the launch.

items.title: Gucci Gift holiday film view/comment activity on YouTube
items.summary: Gucci's official holiday film posted to YouTube is drawing modest view counts in the low thousands relative to Gucci's usual campaign reach, with comment sections echoing the TikTok 'cold'/'outdated' criticism rather than enthusiasm for the Mariah Carey tie-in; exact current view count not independently confirmed at time of collection.

items.source: Instagram (brand + public reaction, via secondary press)
items.title: Gucci official Instagram holiday campaign post and comment reaction
items.summary: Gucci's Instagram posting of the Mariah Carey holiday campaign stills/video drew a split comment section: fan comments praising Carey's styling alongside skeptical comments describing the imagery as 'sterile' and 'devoid of humanity,' consistent with the cross-platform critical reaction captured on TikTok and in press roundups.

items.title: Gucci: is the luxury brand bubble about to burst?
items.summary: Opinion piece arguing Gucci exemplifies a broader luxury bubble risk, citing falling wholesale revenue, declining retail sales, and resale-market softness as evidence that pandemic-era luxury pricing outran brand desirability; used as critical-angle counterweight citing Gucci specifically among at-risk houses.
